title: Build owner inquiry list and detail
requirements: After session bootstrap, render GET /api/v1/admin/inquiries with status, has_visit, channel, opaque cursor and limit filters; reset cursor on filter changes and preserve server ordering.
Render loading, empty, safe error and API summary states; open GET /api/v1/admin/inquiries/{id} and show only accepted detail fields, handling optional visit fields.

Return 401 through common login flow; show safe messages for 403/404/5xx/network; never log payload or PII. Preserve runtime CSRF, credentials include and logout. Calendar and mutations remain placeholders.
Provide responsive mobile cards/desktop layout, keyboard focus, labels and live regions; add dependency-free contract tests under tests/web003.
acceptance: Owner can browse filtered inquiry summaries, paginate with opaque next_cursor and open/close detail while filters persist.
Detail exposes only contract-approved contact, time, service/terms, participation/visit, cash, notes and notification summary fields.
Focused tests cover query/cursor reset, states, errors, 401, navigation preservation and no PII logging; scope and whitespace pass.
